declarations.name: AuiPivotFieldList
declarations.description:
AbsoluteUI Pivot Field List for a Pivot Grid in the same template:
`<aui-pivot-grid #pivot="auiPivotGrid" ...></aui-pivot-grid>
 <aui-pivot-field-list label="Pivot fields" [grid]="pivot"></aui-pivot-field-list>`.
The field list applies layout changes to the grid itself; the grid reports them through
`[(layout)]` and `(layoutChanged)`. Created when the grid exists and re-created when it changes.

inputs.name: grid
inputs.description: The pivot grid it edits: a `#pivot="auiPivotGrid"` reference.

inputs.name: label
inputs.description: Accessible name of the field list.

inputs.name: memberPageSize
inputs.description: Members shown per page in a field filter.

inputs.name: locale
inputs.description: Messages locale (defaults to the configured locale).

outputs.name: fieldMoved
outputs.description: The user moved a field between areas (rows, columns, values, filters, or unused).
